errors.keyFormat: The filename/key must be in English letters, numbers, spaces, - or _.
errors.needText: Enter the Russian text to display.
errors.keyUsed: That key is already used in this part.

errors.needOptions: Every question needs 4 options filled in.

panels.missingTitle: This part needs {{list}} before it can have a comic quiz.
panels.missingHint: The game plays the part's marker lines and asks which panel of the comic page each one happens in.
panels.hintPanels: Drag on the page to add a panel; drag a panel to move it, its corners to resize; Delete removes the selected one.
panels.hintMatch: Click a line to hear it, then click its panel — the next line plays. Keys: 1–9 panel, 0 none, space replay, ↑↓.
panels.gridHint: A starting point for regular pages — then drag the edges onto the real gutters.
panels.emptyPanelNote: Panels don't all need lines — one with none still counts as a wrong answer to tap.
panels.loadingAudio: Loading the audio to measure the last line…
panels.matchRule: Match only lines that describe something drawn in a panel — leave the rest on “no panel”, they are not asked. Neighbouring lines on the same panel are asked as one question.
panels.autoPlay: Play the next line after each match
panels.orphans_one: {{count}} saved line no longer lines up with a marker (the markers moved) and will be dropped on save.
panels.orphans_other: {{count}} saved lines no longer line up with a marker (the markers moved) and will be dropped on save.
panels.saveNeedsMatch: Match at least one line to a panel first

status.saved: Saved — students see it after the part ends

panels.confirmGrid: Replace the panels with an even grid? Lines matched to panels are unmatched.
panels.confirmRemove: Remove the comic quiz from part {{n}}?
